title: Tulane vs UM: tuition, size, location
summary: Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane) versus University of Miami (UM). Also searched as UM vs Tulane. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana and the University of Miami are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Tulane University of Louisiana, located in New Orleans, has an undergraduate enrollment of 7,767 students, while the University of Miami in Coral Gables enrolls 12,913 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Tulane University of Louisiana is $68,678, which is higher compared to the University of Miami's in-state tuition of $62,616. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between Tulane vs UM.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance, Tulane University of Louisiana and the University of Miami show some differences. Tulane University of Louisiana charges $68,678 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition, whereas the University of Miami's tuition is $62,616 for both in-state and out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Tulane University of Louisiana is $20,500, which is higher than the University of Miami's median debt of $17,500. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution, reflecting variations in tuition fees and student borrowing between Tulane vs UM.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana and the University of Miami both offer traditional campus-based learning models in their respective cities. Tulane University of Louisiana is situated in New Orleans, Louisiana, and serves an undergraduate population of 7,767 students. In contrast, the University of Miami is located in Coral Gables, Florida, with a larger undergraduate enrollment of 12,913 students. Both institutions provide a comprehensive collegiate experience through on-campus facilities and resources, reflecting their commitment to in-person education within urban settings. These distinctions in enrollment size and geographic location illustrate some of the key differences in the learning environments between Tulane vs UM.

sections.heading: Pick Tulane if
paragraphs: Pick Tulane University of Louisiana if you are seeking a private nonprofit institution with a selective admission rate of approximately 14%. The university charges a tuition of $68,678, applicable to all students regardless of residency status. Tulane boasts a high completion rate, with about 86% of students finishing their programs within 150% of the expected time. These factors make Tulane a strong choice for students prioritizing academic rigor and timely degree completion.

sections.heading: Pick UM if
paragraphs: Pick the University of Miami if you prefer a private nonprofit institution with a selective admission rate of 18.9%. The university charges $62,616 in tuition for all students, regardless of residency status. It also has a strong completion rate, with approximately 83.7% of students finishing their programs within 150% of the expected time. These factors make the University of Miami a suitable choice for students seeking a rigorous academic environment with a high likelihood of timely degree completion.
